current.text: Stewart was traded to Memphis. He is the backup center behind Zach Edey and is projected to come off the bench.
He could start or make spot starts if Zach Edey misses time. He would have fantasy value as a starter.
The expert treats him as a stash pick and insurance for Edey. He calls the Yahoo rank of 174 fair and the ESPN rank of about 146 aggressive.
He sprained his ankle two minutes into a preseason game. The severity is unknown. Yahoo lists him as out (ankle).
He wants a bigger role and more three-point attempts.
Memphis coach Tuomas Iisalo plays at a very high pace, uses short stints and keeps minutes down. The team runs an 11-man rotation, possibly 12.
Memphis plays the maximum 4-4-4 schedule in our playoff weeks through March 28. It has only 13 back-to-backs, possibly the fewest in the league.

durable.text: He is a good rim protector and a solid rebounder who can hit some threes.
Blocks are his standout category, well above the top 250 pool.
Steals are a clear weakness, far below both the pool and his position.
He has not finished a season healthy in the last three or four years and had many ankle injuries last season.

note: Both Yahoo and ESPN value him at 0 USD. His ranks (Yahoo 174, ESPN 147) put him outside the 144 players drafted in our league, and he is out now with an ankle sprain, so leave him for waivers. His value depends on Zach Edey missing time. As a starter, his blocks (about 1.6 per game) and solid FG% would help punt STL builds, and Memphis has a full 4-4-4 playoff schedule. Early in the season, check how bad the ankle is and whether Edey is healthy, and be ready to spend FAB if Stewart moves into the starting lineup.
